text.작업 폴더의 Claude Code 설정과 .mcp.json(원본은 읽기만: Claude Code settings and .mcp.json in the project folder (the originals are only read)

codes.import.fields_ignored: Some items weren't carried over into the settings.
codes.import.hook_unsupported: hook handlers that aren't commands aren't imported.
codes.import.secret_replaced: Plain-text values were replaced with secret:// references instead of being stored. Register secrets with the same names, for example as environment variables.
codes.import.secret_suspected: Masked values that look like plain-text secrets. Keep secrets as references (secret://).
codes.import.skipped_link: Skipped a symbolic link (or a path that points outside the source).
codes.import.unreadable: Skipped an item that couldn't be read.
